EndpointParam.description:
An endpoint named in command parameters: a function CP, a junction, or a point on an existing
connection (which splits it and creates a junction there, doc 06 §3.5).

JSON: `{"cp": {"function": "…", "idx": 1}}`, `{"junction": {"junction": "…"}}`,
`{"on_connection": {"connection": "…", "at": [x, y]}}`.

oneOf.description: A point on an existing connection's route.

at.description: The point (on the route, if the connection has one).

description:
`plc.bind_channel` (`BindChannel`, doc 10 §3.3, §3.9 `plc.bind_channel{channel, endpoint}`): binds a
channel to its signal CP, rebinds it, or unbinds it (FR-PLC-020).

Sets `Channel.binding` to the CP (`{"cp": {"function", "idx"}}`: a module pin, or the internal CP of
the coil a valve-terminal channel serves) or, with `endpoint: null`, removes it. The channel and the
function exist ([`CmdError::NotFound`]); the CP index must be a CP of the function's FnDef copy (else
rejected); a junction or a point on a connection is not a signal CP (at `/endpoint`). Another channel
bound to the same CP is unbound in the same transaction (a CP is in at most one channel, FR-PLC-005),
and the outcome's notices name it. An explicit binding wins over the solenoid-position map (N2, which
is not built in v0). Outcome: the channel.
title: plc.bind_channel
